outcome: Composite outcome (Apgar score < 7, fetal blood pH < 7.1, or admission to NICU)
cohort: Healthy singleton pregnancies from 32 weeks' gestation with normal estimated fetal weight and a CPR examination between 2014 and 2019 at a university medical center
finding: A CPR model using local reference ranges and a <5th percentile cutoff showed the highest positive predictive value for urgent cesarean delivery and operative delivery.
